$description: Wave 2 (D-013) component tokens for Button/IconButton. Every leaf aliases semantic/* only (never primitive/* directly, per ds-conventions 3-layer rule) — action.*/text.*/border.hairline/overlay.* are all already-locked semantic tokens (D-006, D-008, braun-flat.md). solid = filled bg per action.{intent}.{state} (D-001 accent scarcity: 'primary' intent reserved for the single most important action per view). outline/ghost/link stay bg-transparent and use overlay.hover/overlay.pressed for the non-shadow hover/pressed cue (braun-flat rule 4) instead of any shadow.

outline.$description: Transparent fill, hairline-WIDTH border in the intent color (only the color varies by intent) — satisfies braun-flat rule 1 (definition via border, not shadow) while keeping accent scarcity for primary. neutral uses border.interactive (D-014, QA W2 Wave 2 finding #2), not border.hairline — hairline (neutral.200/800) was designed for quiet layout dividers and measured only 1.24-1.48:1 here, failing the 3:1 WCAG non-text/UI-component minimum that an interactive control's own boundary must meet; border.interactive (neutral.500 both themes) clears 3:1 on canvas/raised in both themes.

ghost.$description: Same text color scheme as outline, no border/bg at rest — hover/active cue comes entirely from overlay.hover/overlay.pressed (braun-flat rule 4).

link.$description: Text-only button (no box at all) — reuses ghost's text color scheme; underline behavior lives in component CSS, not tokens.
